discovery_targets_shape_check.name: discovery_targets_shape_check
discovery_targets_shape_check.value:
("discovery_targets"."kind"='keyword' and "discovery_targets"."scope_key"='' and "discovery_targets"."brand_name" is null)
        or ("discovery_targets"."kind"='brand' and "discovery_targets"."scope_key"<>'' and "discovery_targets"."brand_name" is not null
            and length(btrim("discovery_targets"."brand_name"))>0)

operations_outcome_check.name: operations_outcome_check
operations_outcome_check.value:
(
                ("operations"."status" = 'pending'
                    AND "operations"."resource" IS NULL
                    AND "operations"."error" IS NULL
                    AND "operations"."completed_at" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("operations"."status" = 'completed'
                    AND "operations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
                    AND (("operations"."resource" IS NULL) <> ("operations"."error" IS NULL)))
            )

columns.expression:
(
    setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("title", '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("brand", '')), 'B') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("bullet_1", '')), 'C') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("bullet_2", '')), 'C')
)

products_history_admission_check.name: products_history_admission_check
products_history_admission_check.value:
(
                ("products"."history_admission_state" = 'notAdmitted'
                    AND "products"."history_admission_reason" IS NULL
                    AND "products"."history_admitted_at" IS NULL)
                OR ("products"."history_admission_state" = 'admitted'
                    AND "products"."history_admission_reason" IN ('legacy', 'capacity')
                    AND "products"."history_admission_reason" IS NOT NULL
                    AND "products"."history_admitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
                OR ("products"."history_admission_state" = 'paused'
                    AND "products"."history_admission_reason" = 'capacity'
                    AND "products"."history_admission_reason" IS NOT NULL)
            )
